scope: United States; reported Candida auris clinical cases; aggregate, year of specimen collection

datasets.label: CDC public tracking page
datasets.case_definition: CDC-tracked clinical cases by specimen collection year; may include invasive and non-invasive specimens
datasets.caveat: Reported count changes can reflect screening, reporting, data revisions, and healthcare transmission; reported clinical cases do not equal invasive infections.

datasets.label: CDC corrected MMWR surveillance study
datasets.case_definition: Clinical cases in corrected CDC case-level surveillance analysis by specimen collection year
datasets.caveat: This is a frozen analysis; it must not be substituted for or silently merged with the public tracking page series. Differences reflect data extraction, updates, and surveillance definitions.

suppression.source_rule: CDC displays small geographic counts as '1 to 10' to protect identification of patients or facilities.
suppression.policy: Preserve suppression verbatim. Never infer exact small-cell counts by subtraction; never plot patient- or facility-level locations.

established: Candida auris is a healthcare-associated fungal threat; some isolates are antifungal resistant.
Clinical and screening surveillance cases are distinct.
investigational: The contribution of climate-related selection and fungal thermotolerance to emerging human fungal disease.
interpretation.caution: No data in this package measure the probability or timing of a fungal pandemic.
